user.title: Connect Retrace
user.description: Install and open the Retrace app first. Supervisor discovery normally pairs it automatically. Manual pairing credentials grant read-only access to item locations.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect the Retrace app
hassio_confirm.description: Add tracking entities for this app instance. Development devices are marked Edge. Manage your Apple account and select items in the app. Existing trackers are preserved.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect the app
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the app's replacement read-only pairing token. Apple account reauthentication happens in the app.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the app. Check that it is running.

abort.wrong_instance: This is a different app instance.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot verify the rediscovered app. Existing connection settings were preserved.

apple_reauth.title: Retrace needs you to sign in again
apple_reauth.description: Open the Retrace app and reconnect your Apple account. Apple passwords are not retained. Existing locations remain dated by their original sighting time.

poll_failed.title: Retrace could not refresh locations
poll_failed.description: Open the app to check its status. It will retry with backoff. A successful poll does not guarantee a new Apple sighting.
